_readme: What's new on the Hub, shown on My Hub. Navigation, tools and functions only, never content. One entry per change, newest first: id (lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; never reused or renamed, because members' accounts remember the ids they have seen), date (YYYY-MM-DD, the day it went live), tag (New, Improved or Fixed), title (a few words, no full stop), text (one sentence), showMe (a My Hub control: spec, scope, tools, library, briefing, saved, search, how, new, checklist or pages; or a Hub path such as /medical-sales-hub/calendar/; or null). Process rule: any nav or tool change adds an entry in the same session. Lou approves the wording. Checked by test_whats_new.py.

entries.title: A new My Hub
entries.text: Your specialities, news, tools and saved pages now sit together on one page.

entries.title: Every tool in one place
entries.text: Every Hub tool is now listed on its own and follows your specialities, and Everything shows the rest.

entries.title: Search from My Hub
entries.text: Search every Hub page from My Hub, or press Ctrl K (Cmd K on a Mac).

entries.title: Pages from any profile
entries.text: Your pages can now come from any profile, not only the one you chose.
